reasons: Earliest graduation is after semester 5: the 7 must-take courses cannot fit in one semester (max 5 courses/20 MC), and CS3233 is only offered in Sem 2, so it must be taken in current Y2S2 (semester 4) to finish by Y3S1.
CS3223 and CS4234 are placed in semester 5 after their prerequisites CS2102 and CS3230 are taken in semester 4; CS4234 is offered in Sem 1, which matches semester 5.
